summary: No current public evidence was found that Multicoin Capital operates a founder accelerator named Multicoin Scout Accelerator. Official Multicoin pages describe venture investing and founder pitches, while the similarly named Scout Program is a Chapter One product for angel investors, not a startup accelerator.

sources.title: Multicoin Capital
sources.supports: Official homepage says Multicoin makes long-term crypto investments and its venture fund backs early-stage companies and founders with investments ranging from $1M-$50M; it does not list a Scout Accelerator or cohort dates.

sources.title: Contact - Multicoin Capital
sources.supports: Official contact page invites crypto/blockchain project pitches and includes outreach type 'Pitch an idea for investment', but publishes no accelerator application, deadline, program dates, or cadence.

sources.title: About - Multicoin Capital
sources.supports: Official about page identifies Multicoin as a thesis-driven investment firm managing hedge and venture funds, not as an accelerator operator.

sources.title: Scout Program
sources.supports: Similarly named Scout Program says it is a Chapter One product where 10 angel investors deploy $100K each; Kyle Samani is listed as a mentor, but it is not a Multicoin founder accelerator.

notes: Searches for 'Multicoin Scout Accelerator', 'Multicoin Scout', 'Multicoin Scout Program', and official Multicoin pages did not reveal a current founder accelerator page.
Because no public application window, cohort cadence, founder eligibility, or organizer page for the named accelerator was found, no event record should be merged.
